PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P1 - Inference service (eu-west-1) firing - high 5xx rate on /v1/generate. Pager: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-3421 — auto-escalating to eng-oncall.
Sam H: acked — I'm taking this. putting bridge in #incident-bridge-3421.
Maria L: thx @Sam H — do we have customer-facing impact? any active SLAs affected?
Sam H: looks like traffic spike + a routing fallback loop. early signs: worker pool returning 502s when kvcache misses spike. not yet seeing consistent customer errors but visible elevated error rate in prod for the last 90s.
Sanjay P: adding logs from the inference edge:
```
[2026-02-18T09:22:01Z] inference-edge-3 - upstream error: redis timeout -> fallback to default model -> 503
[2026-02-18T09:22:02Z] kvcache-evict - eviction burst, miss_rate=0.73
[2026-02-18T09:22:05Z] router - route retry 3 -> overloaded_pool
```
Sam H: initial mitigation: increasing dedicated pool scaling target (rbac:devops/scaler scale pool-inference-eu 6->12), and temporarily disabling cross-region fallback. Applying now.
Keiko: pinged Dedicated autoscaler to speed up, seen a couple of queued requests for large sequences.
PagerBot: Event: scale request submitted by Sam H (job 6721). Estimated warm-up 45s.
Maria L: customer-impact: I queried top 10 customer tenants, only 2 showed elevated latencies but no sustained 5xx. reach out plan?
Sam H: plan: (1) scale up pool (in flight), (2) roll routing to avoid overloaded pool, (3) enable read-through kvcache warmup, (4) if persists, failover to a lighter quantized model for best-effort.
Sanjay P: started a warmup job to prefill prefix cache for hot prefixes. command: `python tools/kvcache_prefill.py --region eu-west-1 --prefixes-file /tmp/hot.txt`
Keiko: observed autoscaler accepted the scale; nodes provisioning: 4/6 up, 2/6 pending.
Sam H: status update — after +60s: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 6% but still noisy. moving to reroute 20% of traffic away from pool-inference-eu to pool-fallback-quantized.
Maria L: I'll draft a short customer note (internal) in case we need to send external comms. tagging accounts for the two tenants with spikes.
PagerBot: PagerDuty: INC-3421 acked by Sam H (eng-oncall). Escalation level: owner assigned.
TJ N: night-oncall here — I'm shadowing; if you need handoff later I'd prefer a 5-10m overlap.
Sam H: good call. @TJ N I'll do a handoff summary at 09:40Z if still active.
Sanjay P: reroute applied via router sauce: `routeset apply -s eu-main -t pool-fallback-quantized -p 20%` — confirmed in logs, traffic shift started.
Sam H: small regression observed — some requests now hitting quantized path return slightly different output structure for certain `function_call` cases. added a filter to only route non-tool-calls.
Maria L: noted for customers — we will call this a limited best-effort routing to preserve availability, not full feature parity.
Keiko: nodes are now 6/6 provisioned, warmup completes in ~20s per node.
Sam H: after reroute + full scale: 5xx rate stabilized ~1.2%, latency returned to baseline for majority. keeping monitoring for 15m.
PagerBot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: INC-3421 - severity reduced, owner Sam H updated notes.
Maria L: customer impact summary (internal): two tenants saw transient latency spikes ~2-3m, no data loss, degraded outputs for <5% of requests due to quantized fallback. recommend no outbound customer comms unless they open a ticket.
Sam H: prepping runbook blurb and post-incident action items: 1) tighten kvcache eviction thresholds on high-miss patterns, 2) auto-warm new nodes with hot prefixes, 3) make quantized fallback transparent for function-calls, 4) increase autoscaler warm pool minimum for peak windows.
Sanjay P: logging note: add a specific metric for cross-region fallback retries (router.retry_cross_region_count) so we can alert earlier.
Keiko: @Sam H ready for handoff?
Sam H: yes. Handoff to @TJ N at 09:40Z. brief: scaled dedicated pool from 6->12, temporarily disabled cross-region fallback, enabled 20% quantized routing for non-tool calls, warmup job ran. current status: stable at low error rate, monitoring for 15m. runbook link: http://confluence/runbooks/inference-kv-eviction
TJ N: thanks — will monitor and escalate if error rate creeps >3% for 5m. please DM if anything else.
Maria L: adding follow-up ticket for runbook updates and postmortem notes.
Sam H: closing on this thread for now — leaving PD incident open for a bit until monitoring window passes. great teamwork. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: Incident INC-3421: status updated -> monitoring.
TJ N: acknowledged handoff.
Maria L: reaction :eyes: — I'll pull the graphs for the postmortem.
Sam H: last note: we'll schedule a quick 20m sync tomorrow to finalise action owners.
